title: Live isolated direct inspection proof
objective: Read the exact Codex no-tool route and Runner launch isolation from current source, then return a compact factual report without changing files or invoking any optional capability.
scope: the child's visible route and capability envelope

may: read src/pipeline.js and src/runner.js with direct shell, rg, or sed inspection
read the route-scoped handoff supplied to this child
report exact observed fields and whether a skill catalog or optional tool routes were advertised
may_not: invoke web, MCP, plugins, skills, subagents, review, another provider, or fallback
inspect global user configuration or global capability directories
push, merge, deploy, install, or send terminal input

relevant_context: Report the selected provider, model, effort, execution class, selected tool, and every disabled optional capability from the route in your handoff.
State whether any skill catalog, MCP/plugin route, web route, subagent route, or reviewer route was advertised to you; do not attempt to invoke an unavailable route.
Keep the final report under 250 words.
expected_deliverable: A compact no-change source inspection report matching the exact route and visible child capability envelope.
acceptance_criteria: the child identifies the Codex provider, selected model and effort, bounded implementation class, and selected_tool none
the child reports empty skill, MCP server, plugin, and fallback allowlists
the child reports web, subagents, and review disabled
the child reports whether any unrelated skill catalog or optional route was advertised
only direct source inspection commands are invoked
